findings: WITHDRAWN: the round-24 run used GET (no body/method) — all its abort conclusions are void.
Termination is observable IMMEDIATELY (0.0s): the session left the busy state at once.
Turn 1 after abort: model reply NEVER delivered (no P0_DONE), yet the assistant message is FLAGGED completed — 'completed' is not evidence the work finished.
Late abort issued while turn 2 ran KILLED turn 2 instantly (reply never delivered) — the destructive late-arrival window is REAL; resume must stay blocked until uncertainty is isolated.
No graceful HTTP shutdown endpoint (POST /shutdown returns the SPA HTML).
This environment: SIGTERM ignored for 12s, only SIGKILL terminated the CLI (zombie reaped via /proc) — environment-specific, not generalizable.
Mock boundary: the mock cannot react to cancellations; delivery evidence comes from the real opencode server's own status/message records.
